text:
maria: quick heads-up — i'm assembling the release blurb for the docs site. want to finalize the release framing + known-issues list before i publish. PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123

sam: looking now. do we still call out the streaming embeddings quirk?

maria: yes, include a short note: users may see truncated embed streams when payloads > 4MB. link to workaround in the migration guide.

chris: i pushed a tiny snippet fix to the go sdk examples in that PR (changed paginated iterator example). pls verify the output block.

lee: saw that — the code block needed `defer it.Close()` added. tested locally.

jen: can we also add a short example for the new fallback routing policy? customers keep asking for a minimal snippet.

maria: good call. draft snippet below — feedback welcome:
```go
// simple fallback routing example
client := redwood.NewClient("$API_KEY")
resp, _ := client.Generate(ctx, redwood.GenerateRequest{
  Model: "redwood-kitefish-v1",
  Fallbacks: []string{"redwood-kitefish-v1-quant", "gpt-compatible-fallback"},
})
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```

sam: LGTM. maybe add a one-line note about tokenization differences for the quantized fallback.

maria: good point — will add a parenthetical.

chris: for the changelog bullets, i'd keep them short — 3 bullets: new fallback routing, streaming embedding quirk (with link), go sdk snippet fix. detailed migration steps go in the migration guide.

lee: i found one broken doc link in the rollout section: /docs/dedicated/autoscale -> 404. PR #4124 queued to redirect.

maria: thanks lee — i'll reference that in the known issues as "redirect in progress" so readers know it's being fixed.

jen: small nit: in the whatsnew blurb, can we avoid product marketing language? engineering tone — factual bullets. saves marketing spin in the docs changelog.

maria: agreed. i'll keep it technical and add a callout for customers who want a walkthrough (contact support).

docs-bot: reminder — docs release schedule: staging -> tomorrow 10:00 UTC, prod -> after signoff.

sam: can we get a quick LGTM thread? i can do a final pass on the examples and run the docsite build locally.

maria: timeline: final edits tonight, signoff by 08:00 UTC, staging deploy 10:00 UTC.

chris: LGTM from me. ran the examples.

lee: LGTM (redirect PR included).

jen: LGTM — added fallback note suggestion to the PR.

maria: thanks everyone — i'll squash and merge after i add the tokenization parenthetical and the redirect note. i'll post back once staging is live. :rocket:
